messages:
Aisha (CS): MerchantX reached out — new QA + Docs team started onboarding yesterday. They’re running doc-summarization + automated test-case generation. Token usage ~2.3x WoW and a few p95 latency spikes reported. They asked about quota bump, warm pools, and whether Dedicated makes sense. Also flagged flaky behaviour on long batch runs. Can we triage? :eyes:
Liam (Solutions Eng): which models/seq lengths are they using? if they have many long contexts we should recommend KV caching + sequence cap. Can you paste 7d request distribution or a quick screenshot?
Aisha (CS): attaching quick perf snippet and dashboard link (internal): https://dash.redwood/internal/merchantx/usage — p50 ~120ms, p95 jumped from 420ms -> 1.1s during peak windows. Most requests are 2–3k tokens (doc extract + QA).
Marco (AM): Heads-up — renewal Q3. This expansion could materially increase ARR if we land it, but sustained latency will raise churn risk. Want a short proposal we can show execs if we recommend Dedicated pilot.
Liam (Solutions Eng): for long sequences I’d push two immediate mitigations: 1) enable prefix/KV caching for repeated doc contexts, 2) use quantized variants for non-critical quality paths. Also recommend autoscale config with a small warm pool during their spike windows. Example CLI to provision a warm pool:```redwoodctl capacity set --team merchantx --min 2 --max 8 --warm-pool 2```
OpsBot: Note: No incident tickets open for MerchantX in the last 30d. Historical deploys: 2026-02-08 14:12 UTC (no rollbacks).
Aisha (CS): Customer also asked for better per-route cost visibility and an exportable CSV of eval runs — they want to show finance. Capturing feedback here for product/console team.
Marco (AM): Proposed commercial path: 3-month Dedicated pilot (2-GPU pool) + canary routing for critical routes. Offer 10% pilot credit or 20% on committed annual if they convert. I’ll draft numbers.
Liam (Solutions Eng): I can own a 45–60min enablement workshop (demo batching, cache, trace hooks). I’ll prepare a short runbook and a live demo of the per-route cost dashboard.
Aisha (CS): Plan: 1) Draft pilot + pricing (Marco) 2) Enablement session next week (Liam) 3) Temporary quota bump + warm-pool during pilot (ops). I’ll schedule a sync with MerchantX CSM and loop in their infra owner.
Marco (AM): Sounds good. I’ll prepare the executive one-pager and estimated ARR uplift.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Will add a short checklist for the runbook — QoS, sequence caps, KV caching, monitoring alerts.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: I’ll send the customer-facing note after we align. Will include the feature ask about exportable eval CSVs in the product feedback tracker.
Marco (AM): :ok_hand:
Liam (Solutions Eng): :+1:
